verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Gumroad serves an llms.txt at https://gumroad.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is agent-oriented: it describes the storefront URL structure, links the public REST API docs, and points to OAuth + MCP access for agents. Markdown docs (api.md) and OpenAPI specs return 404, so the agent-oriented docs stop at the llms.txt index. missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable versions of the full API docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of agents successfully using the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://gumroad.com/llms.txt # Gumroad
[API documentation](https://gumroad.com/api): public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
